title: Hardware Interrupt
text: 从中断服务例程触发下游函数调用子系统；输出 1 路；按 {Interrupt name} 指定ISR；{Interrupt group} 指定外设 ISR External interrupts、{Interrupt number} 指定 ISR 在中断表中的位置、{Events to serve} 指定事件 EXTI0、{Simulink task priority} 指定所选 ISR 的优先级、{Run interrupt service routine as atomic unit} 指定此项以禁用中断抢占、{Clear status after servicing each event} 指定此项以清除中断状态标志，按实例取值。

params.name: Interrupt group
params.values: 选择外设 ISR External interrupts (EXTI) (default) | Analog to digital converter (ADC) | Pulse width modulation (PWM) | Direct memory access (DMA)

params.name: Interrupt name
params.values: 选择 ISR EXTI0_IRQHandler (default) | ADC_IRQHandler | TIM1_BRK_TIM9_IRQHandler | DMA0_Stream0_IRQHandler

params.name: Interrupt number
params.values: ISR 在中断表中的位置 21 (default) | 33 | 71 | …

params.name: Events to serve
params.values: 选择事件 EXTI0 Event (default) | ADC1 OVR | Stream0 TC | …

params.name: Simulink task priority
params.values: 设置所选 ISR 的优先级 30 (default) | positive integer or nonnegative integer

params.name: Run interrupt service routine as atomic unit
params.values: 选择此项以禁用中断抢占 off (default) | on

params.name: Clear status after servicing each event
params.values: 选择此项以清除中断状态标志 off (default) | on
